TC-101.goal: Open https://odjafrik.com/nonexistent-page-xyz and stop. Do not navigate elsewhere. Report the final URL and whether the page explicitly shows a 404 or an equivalent "page introuvable" message.
TC-101.label: une page d'erreur 404 explicite

TC-103.goal: Open https://odjafrik.com/products, wait until the product list is visible, then reload the page once and stop. Do not apply filters and do not click a product. Report the number of products displayed before and after reload.
TC-103.label: au moins un produit dans le catalogue

TC-ECOM-001.goal: Type "Agonlin" into the header search field labelled "Rechercher des produits, fournisseurs...", then press Enter exactly once. Stop immediately after the results page shows the products. Do not click the search button or any other control.
TC-ECOM-001.label: des produits pour la recherche Agonlin

TC-ECOM-002.goal: Confirm the category page lists at least one product. Stop immediately after confirming; do not click anything.
TC-ECOM-002.label: au moins un produit dans la catégorie

TC-ECOM-003.goal: Wait until the product page shows the product name, price and stock status. Do not scroll and do not click any link. Stop as soon as the information is visible.
TC-ECOM-003.label: le nom, le prix et le stock du produit

TC-ECOM-004.goal: On this product page, click the button labelled "Ajouter" exactly once. Then navigate to https://odjafrik.com/cart and stop when the cart shows "Les merveilles d’Agonlin Long grain". Do not use the search field, do not log in and do not proceed to checkout.
TC-ECOM-004.label: le produit ajouté au panier
